scope: Secret-free elapsed progress diagnostics for an existing read-only provider recovery flow. No timeout, retry, send, credential, or provider policy changed.

diagnosticContract.events: ProbeProgressEvent::Started and ::Completed with a closed, content-free ProbeProgressPhase enum.
diagnosticContract.timeoutBehavior: The active fixed operation is persisted before awaiting it and remains present if the enclosing recovery deadline cancels that operation.

verification.core: cargo test -p dakia-core --lib probe_progress_tests --locked: 6 passed, 0 failed, 730 filtered
verification.cli: cargo test -p dakia-cli --bin dakia-provider-smoke --locked: 22 passed, 0 failed
verification.independentReview: Approved by probe_review after rerunning the focused core and CLI suites.
verification.sensitivity: A private mutant clearing active timeout state failed recovery_timeout_evidence_retains_the_cancelled_active_operation_without_sensitive_data with actual activeOperation null versus exact_search; the source was restored and the 22-test CLI suite passed.

transportProvenance.evidence: A pre-instrument target/debug/dakia-provider-smoke artifact, mtime 2026-10-21 18:19:05 and SHA-256 a773cd5ff042121f5defbed80b22fb3f93a690422933c5bfe03a610c7ee618ef, has no progress symbols. Independent DWARF/disassembly review established the pre-existing SMTP order connect_tokio1, conditional STARTTLS, explicit EHLO, unchanged credentials/default mechanisms authentication, then QUIT; IMAP already performed post-TLS CAPABILITY/validation and probe CAPABILITY, validation, authentication.
transportProvenance.conclusion: The diagnostics wrap the existing command flow and do not introduce a transport-policy change.

limitations: Detailed transport phases cover only the initial IMAP and SMTP authentication probes.
Later recovery steps retain only their high-level operation name; a timeout there cannot be attributed to an internal fresh connection's TLS or authentication phase.
SMTP connect includes Lettre's implicit-TLS connection work and does not claim an independently observed TLS-handshake phase.
No external provider recovery was run after this diagnostic change.
